The three packet elements are launch frontend (XML/YAML) action tag names, registered through the expose_action decorator (launch/launch/frontend/expose.py:115-121, stored in action_parse_methods keyed by name). The declaration line recorded for each is the expose_action decorator line; the decorated classes are GroupAction (group_action.py:35), IncludeLaunchDescription (include_launch_description.py:39) and SetEnvironmentVariable (set_environment_variable.py:32), all exported from launch.actions (actions/__init__.py:20,21,28). Each name is exposed exactly once in the package (grep of expose_action across the snapshot). No packet element is consumed, so references is empty. ExecuteProcess (a different element, execute_process.py:109-110) offers an opt-in respawn/respawn_delay parameter (default False); it was not counted as a recovery declaration for the listed elements.
